page.notes: Printed Arabic and mixed Arabic/Latin lines are transcribed as far as legible; some Arabic words in the scan are blurred and the exact letters are uncertain (marked [?] where most doubtful). "pagnam" is copied as printed (probably "pugnam" in intent). The reference mark "*" in the text is followed by the note "i.e. Temporibus ignorantiæ eo jejunabant" in the left margin. The side notes "AlJaubar.", "Id.", "AlMakriz." and "AlJauhar." stand in the left margin beside the lines to which they belong; the note "Id." is placed beside the "mada" line. The page is a continuous column, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page.
